## Heat Pump Installation {-}

```{r gas, include=FALSE}
# get install date
hp_install_date <- fread("../data/input/cosy_-_hp_details_2024_06_25.csv") %>%
  select(account_id, installed_at) %>%
  mutate(installed_at = as.Date(installed_at)) %>%
  distinct(installed_at, account_id)

# get people from the survey responders
survey_responses <- fread("../data/input/responses.csv") %>%
  select(-Other) %>% 
  rename(account_number = kid) %>%
  inner_join(fread("../data/input/survey_ids.csv"))  %>%
  mutate(installed_at_2 = as.Date(`When was your heat pump installed?`)) %>%
  distinct(installed_at_2, account_id) %>%
  group_by(account_id) %>%
  arrange(account_id, installed_at_2) %>% 
  slice(1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(installed_at_2), !is.na(account_id))

# merge gas, cosy adoption and weather data
gas_readings <- fread("../data/input/cosy_-_cosy_gas_readings_2024_06_27.csv") %>%
  select(-mpan) %>%
  distinct() 

# get weekly weather
weather <- fread("../data/input/cosy_-_weather_weekly_2024_06_13.csv") 


# ev half hours 
# Read the CSV file
ev_charging <- fread("../data/input/cosy_-_ev_detection_2024_07_04.csv") %>%
  mutate(ev_charging = 1,
         adjusted_date = as.POSIXct(interval_start, format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
         settlement_week = floor_date(as.Date(adjusted_date), "week")+1) %>%
  group_by(account_id,, settlement_week) %>%
  tally() %>%
  rename(ev_charging=n)

# EV users details
ev_users <- fread("../data/input/cosy_-_ev_detection_2024_07_04.csv")  %>%
  group_by(account_id) %>%
  summarise(is_ev_detected= min(as.Date(interval_start)))


# create weekly data
weekly_data <- readRDS("../data/scratch/aggregated_data.RDS") %>%
  filter(rate_period == "Overall")  %>%
  mutate(settlement_week = floor_date(date, "week")+1) %>%
  group_by(account_id,  gsp_group_id, settlement_week) %>%
  summarise(total_consumption = sum(total_consumption),
            cosy_contract_active = round(mean(cosy_contract_active))) %>%
  left_join(weather %>% rename(settlement_week=week_date)) %>%
  left_join(hp_install_date)  %>%
  left_join(survey_responses)  %>%
  left_join(gas_readings) %>%
  left_join(ev_charging) %>%
  left_join(ev_users) %>%
  arrange(account_id, settlement_week) %>%
  mutate(is_hp_installed = ifelse(!is.na(installed_at), 
                                  as.numeric(installed_at <= settlement_week),
                                  ifelse(!is.na(installed_at_2),  as.numeric(installed_at_2 <= settlement_week),
                                         NA)),
         gas_user = as.numeric(account_id %in% gas_readings$account_id),
         ev_user = as.numeric(settlement_week >= is_ev_detected),
         gas_rolling_avg = zoo::rollapply(weekly_consumption, width = 3, FUN = mean, align = "right", fill = NA),
         elec_rolling_avg = zoo::rollapply(total_consumption, width = 3, FUN = mean, align = "right", fill = NA),
         gas_diff = c(NA, diff(weekly_consumption)),
         elec_diff = c(NA, diff(total_consumption))) %>%
  select(total_consumption, weekly_consumption, avg_heating_degree, is_hp_installed, settlement_week, cosy_contract_active, gsp_group_id) 

features <- weekly_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(is_hp_installed)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 3: Train-Test Split
set.seed(123)
split_accounts <- sample(unique(features$account_id), size = 0.7 * length(unique(features$account_id)))

train_data <- features %>% filter(account_id %in% split_accounts)
test_data <- features  %>% filter(!account_id %in% split_accounts)

train_features <- train_data %>%
  select(-is_hp_installed)
train_target <- train_data$is_hp_installed

test_features <- test_data %>%
  select(-is_hp_installed)
test_target <- test_data$is_hp_installed

# Step 4: Model Training (Random Forest Classifier)
model <- train(
  train_features, as.factor(train_target),
  method = "rf",
  ntree = 100
)

# Step 5: Model Evaluation
predictions <- predict(model, test_features)
confusion_matrix <- confusionMatrix(predictions, as.factor(test_target))

# Feature importance plot (from the random forest model)
importance <- varImp(model, scale = FALSE)

# Create the plot
ggplot(importance, aes(x = reorder(Variables, Overall), y = Overall)) +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity') +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Features", y = "Importance")

# Save the plot
ggsave("../graphs/importance.png")
```

``` {r}
# Prepare a data frame with the original test data and predictions
results <- data.frame(
  settlement_week = test_data$settlement_week,
  Actual = test_target,
  Predicted = predictions
)

# Function to classify predictions into true positive, false positive, etc.
get_prediction_type <- function(actual, predicted) {
  if (actual == 1 && predicted == 1) {
    return("True Positive")
  } else if (actual == 0 && predicted == 1) {
    return("False Positive")
  } else if (actual == 1 && predicted == 0) {
    return("False Negative")
  } else {
    return("True Negative")
  }
}

# Apply the function to classify each row
results$PredictionType <- mapply(get_prediction_type, results$Actual, results$Predicted)

# Summarize by month
time_summary <- results %>%
  group_by(settlement_week, PredictionType) %>%
  summarize(Count = n(), .groups = 'drop')

# Plot using ggplot2
ggplot(time_summary, aes(x = settlement_week, y = Count, color = PredictionType, shape = PredictionType, group = PredictionType)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "True Positive" = 16,  # Filled circle
      "True Negative" = 17,  # Filled triangle
      "False Positive" = 1,  # Empty circle
      "False Negative" = 2   # Empty triangle
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Week",
    y = "Count",
    color = "Prediction Type",
    shape = "Prediction Type"
  )

# Save the plot
ggsave("../graphs/predictions_over_time.png")


```


```{r attachedpredictions, eval=FALSE}

# Prepare the features from the original merged dataset (ensure the same feature engineering is applied)
merged_data <-  weekly_data %>%
  filter(is.na(is_hp_installed)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Make predictions using the trained model
predictions <- predict(model, merged_data)

# Add predictions back to the dataset
merged_data$predicted_is_hp_installed <- as.numeric(predictions)-1

# Check the first few rows to confirm predictions are attached
predicted_counts <- merged_data %>%
  full_join(features) %>%
  mutate(
    # Step 1: Prioritize `is_hp_installed` if not missing
    predicted_is_hp_installed = ifelse(!is.na(is_hp_installed), is_hp_installed, predicted_is_hp_installed),
    # # Step 2: Propagate `1` if it was present in a previous month for this `hashed_mpan`
    # predicted_is_hp_installed = cummax(predicted_is_hp_installed)
  ) %>%
  group_by(account_id) %>%
  filter(predicted_is_hp_installed==1) %>%
  summarise(pred_installed_at = min(settlement_week))
saveRDS(predicted_counts, "../data/scratch/predicted_counts.RDS")

# Aggregate the number of HP for each date
predicted_counts %>%
  group_by(pred_installed_at) %>%
  tally() %>%
  # Plot the aggregated data using a bar chart
  ggplot(aes(x = as.Date(pred_installed_at), y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "blue") +
  scale_x_date(
    labels = scales::date_format("%w %b %y"),  # Formatting months and years
    date_breaks = "3 month"  # Adjust this based on your data density
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Total HP"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)  # Improve readability by rotating labels
  )

ggsave("../graphs/predicted_HP_installations.png")


# Check the impact of HP installation
aggregated_data <-  readRDS("../data/scratch/aggregated_data.RDS") %>%
  left_join(predicted_counts) %>%
  mutate(predicted_is_hp_installed = as.numeric(pred_installed_at <= date))

m1 <- feols(consumption_hh ~ i(cosy_contract_active, ref=0) | account_id + date + daily_avg_heating_degree, 
            data = aggregated_data,
            split = ~ rate_period,
            cluster = ~ account_id)

m2 <- feols(consumption_hh ~ i(cosy_contract_active, ref=0) + i(predicted_is_hp_installed, ref=0) | account_id + date + daily_avg_heating_degree, 
            data = aggregated_data,
            split = ~ rate_period,
            cluster = ~ account_id)

etable(m2)

etable(m1, tex=TRUE, title = "Impact of Predicted Heat Pump Installations (restricted to winter months)",
       label="tab:hp-impact",
       fitstat = ~ N + g + pre_avg +t_obs + r2, file = "../tables/hp_impact.tex", replace = TRUE)
```
